'''NT-757'''<ref name="JKTCG" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Complete Visual" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who wielded an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A fearless [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], NT-757 had a knack for controlling local populations during important Imperial operations.<ref name="JKTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
NT-757 first appeared on a card for the [[Masters of the Force (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Masters of the Force'']] expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[2001]] ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JKTCG" />
